userStories.title: Add failing-test rectification prompt with escape hatch
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add a declaration-aware failing-test rectification prompt while preserving the existing `failingTestContext` output.

**Motivation** — When a failing test is caused by a genuinely-buggy test fixture (rather than a source bug), the implementer has no sanctioned way to declare a legitimate test edit, and the `mock_structure` → test-writer handoff that every other rectification source can reach is unreachable here.

**Approach** — Add `RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestRectification(findings, story)` that composes the failing-test listing with `testEditHeadline` + `escapeHatchFor` and preserves the assertion-loosening guard. Extract the existing bullet-list body of `failingTestContext` into a shared helper in `rectifier-builder-helpers.ts` so `failingTestContext`'s output is unchanged and the oversized `rectifier-builder.ts` does not grow (see Design § File-size constraint). Both methods stay on the class as thin static facades delegating to the helper functions.

**Scope** — In: `src/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder.ts`, `src/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder-helpers.ts`, and the prompt-builder unit tests. Out: any strategy wiring, op parsing, sink handling, or declaration application.

**Interface**
```text
RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestRectification(findings, story)
RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestContext(findings)
testEditHeadline(story, prohibition)
escapeHatchFor(story)
```
acceptanceCriteria: Given a `test-runner` failed-test finding whose `rule` is `should reject expired token` and `message` is `Expected 1 received 0`, when `RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestContext([finding])` is called, then the returned string contains `should reject expired token`, `Expected 1 received 0`, and `Fix the implementation (not the tests)`.

Given a three-session story with `routing.testStrategy = "tdd"`, when `RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestRectification([finding], story)` is called, then the returned string contains the finding error message, `TEST_EDIT_REASON`, and `mock_structure`.
Given a three-session story, when `RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestRectification([finding], story)` is called, then the returned string contains `loosen assertion`.

Given a single-session story with `routing.testStrategy = "test-after"`, when `RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestRectification([finding], story)` is called, then the returned string contains the single-session direct-edit permit and does not contain `mock_structure`.

routing.reasoning: This story modifies two existing prompt-builder modules and extends their unit coverage, but it stays within established prompt-composition patterns.

userStories.title: Add declaration-aware full-suite rectification op
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Introduce a dedicated rectification op for full-suite failures that builds the new prompt and parses `TEST_EDIT_REASON` declarations.

**Motivation** — Root cause: `makeFullSuiteRectifyStrategy` (`src/operations/full-suite-rectify.ts`) uses `fixOp: implementerOp` (run stage) and builds its prompt from `RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestContext()`, which — unlike the sibling full-suite method at `rectifier-builder.ts:856-861` — appends neither `testEditHeadline()` nor `escapeHatchFor(story)`.

**Approach** — Add a `RunOperation` (`kind: "run"`, `name: "full-suite-rectify"`, `stage: "rectification"`, `session: { role: "implementer", lifetime: "warm" }`, `config: autofixConfigSelector`) whose `build` calls `RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestRectification` and whose `parse` runs `parseTestEditDeclarations`. Export it from the operations barrel.

**Scope** — In: the new rectification op, its barrel export, and unit tests for build/parse behavior. Out: strategy routing, declaration sink mutation, or declaration application to findings.

**Interface**
```text
RunOperation (`kind: "run"`, `name: "full-suite-rectify"`, `stage: "rectification"`, `session: { role: "implementer", lifetime: "warm" }`, `config: autofixConfigSelector`)
RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestRectification
parseTestEditDeclarations(output)
```
acceptanceCriteria: When `fullSuiteRectifyOp` is imported from `src/operations`, then `kind === "run"`, `name === "full-suite-rectify"`, and `stage === "rectification"`.

Given a three-session story and one failed-test finding, when `fullSuiteRectifyOp.build({ story, findings: [finding] })` is called, then the returned prompt task content equals `RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestRectification([finding], story)` and contains `TEST_EDIT_REASON`.

Given output containing a `TEST_EDIT_REASON: mock_structure` block naming a test file, when `fullSuiteRectifyOp.parse(output, { story, findings })` is called, then it returns an object where `applied === true` and `testEditDeclarations[0].reason === "mock_structure"` and `testEditDeclarations[0].files` includes the named file.

Given output with no `TEST_EDIT_REASON` block, when `fullSuiteRectifyOp.parse(output, { story, findings })` is called, then it returns an object where `applied === true` and `testEditDeclarations` equals `[]`.

routing.reasoning: This story adds one new run-op module plus a barrel export and unit tests, and it reuses the existing rectification parse/build conventions.

userStories.title: Wire full-suite declarations into the main rectification cycle
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Upgrade the full-suite rectify strategy and the main rectification cycle so full-suite failing-test declarations flow through the shared sink, post-validation, and test-writer handoff.

**Motivation** — Failing-test findings therefore take a declaration-blind detour.

**Approach** — Upgrade `makeFullSuiteRectifyStrategy(story, config, sink)` to accept the shared `DeclarationSink`, set `fixOp: fullSuiteRectifyOp`, and have `extractApplied` push parsed declarations into the sink (`mock_structure` → `mockHandoffs`, others → `testEdits`). Relax the `prd_contract` re-tag predicate in `applyTestEditDeclarations` to also accept `fixTarget == null && source === "test-runner"`, so failing-test findings (which carry no `fixTarget`) are re-tag-eligible on the cycle findings without affecting other sources. Wire the shared `sink` at the main rectification call site in `build-plan-for-strategy.ts`; pass `nbSink` at the non-blocking-fix call site with a comment pointing at #1227.

**Scope** — In: `src/operations/full-suite-rectify.ts`, `src/operations/apply-test-edit-declarations.ts`, `src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts`, the new `fullSuiteRectifyOp` consumption, and strategy/application/integration tests. Out: changing strategy routing ownership, adding new escape-hatch reasons, or making the ADR-024 non-blocking fix path honor declarations end to end.

**Interface**
```text
makeFullSuiteRectifyStrategy(story, config, sink)
fullSuiteRectifyOp
DeclarationSink (`{ testEdits, mockHandoffs }`)
applyTestEditDeclarations(findings, allDeclarations, story, invalid)
```
acceptanceCriteria: Given `makeDeclarationSink()`, when `makeFullSuiteRectifyStrategy(story, config, sink)` is called, then the returned strategy has `fixOp === fullSuiteRectifyOp`.
Given `makeDeclarationSink()`, when `makeFullSuiteRectifyStrategy(story, config, sink)` is called, then `appliesTo({ source: "test-runner", category: "failed-test" }) === true`.
Given `makeDeclarationSink()`, when `makeFullSuiteRectifyStrategy(story, config, sink)` is called, then `appliesTo({ source: "semantic-review", category: "x" }) === false`.

Given a `test-runner` failed-test finding for file `F` with no `fixTarget` and a valid `prd_contract` declaration for file `F` whose `prdQuote` appears verbatim in `story`, when `applyTestEditDeclarations([finding], [declaration], story)` is called, then the returned finding for `F` has `fixTarget === "test"`.

Given a `lint` finding for file `F` with no `fixTarget` and a valid `prd_contract` declaration for file `F`, when `applyTestEditDeclarations([finding], [declaration], story)` is called, then the returned finding for `F` still has `fixTarget` unset.

Given a strategy built with a fresh sink, when `extractApplied` receives an op output containing one `mock_structure` declaration with `files` and `reasonDetail`, then `sink.mockHandoffs` contains one matching entry.
Given a strategy built with a fresh sink, when `extractApplied` receives an op output containing one `prd_contract` declaration, then `sink.testEdits` contains that declaration.

Given a three-session story, a rectification cycle seeded with a `test-runner` failed-test finding, the shared sink wired via `buildPlanForStrategy`, and a stub implementer adapter whose output declares `TEST_EDIT_REASON: mock_structure` naming an existing test file that matches the resolved test-file patterns, when the cycle runs, then the `autofix-test-writer` fix op is dispatched with that file present in its mock-restructure handoff input.

Given an invalid `mock_structure` declaration whose files do not exist or do not match the resolved test-file patterns, when the main-cycle `postValidate` path applies declarations, then it appends an advisory finding with `category === "mock_structure_invalid_files"` and does not enqueue a test-writer handoff for that declaration.

Given a `test-runner` failed-test finding with no `fixTarget` and a `prd_contract` declaration whose `prdQuote` does not appear verbatim in `story`, when `applyTestEditDeclarations([finding], [declaration], story)` is called, then the returned findings append one advisory with `category === "prd_quote_mismatch"` and the original finding still has no `fixTarget`.

Given a single-session story where agent output still includes `TEST_EDIT_REASON: mock_structure`, when the rectification cycle runs without an `autofix-test-writer` strategy, then the cycle completes without throwing and no test-writer strategy is dispatched for that declaration.

routing.reasoning: This story changes the strategy factory, the declaration application path, and the main execution plan wiring, and it needs end-to-end rectification behavior proven across multiple modules.

analysis:
Existing full-suite rectification is declaration-blind today. `makeFullSuiteRectifyStrategy()` still uses `implementerOp`, builds `contextMarkdown` from `RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestContext(findings)`, and its `extractApplied` ignores agent output, so failing-test rectification cannot emit or persist `TEST_EDIT_REASON` blocks (`src/operations/full-suite-rectify.ts:17`, `src/operations/full-suite-rectify.ts:26`, `src/operations/full-suite-rectify.ts:27`, `src/operations/full-suite-rectify.ts:31`). The current failing-test prompt is a short listing plus the hard prohibition `Fix the implementation (not the tests)` and does not append `testEditHeadline()` or `escapeHatchFor()` (`src/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder.ts:883`, `src/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder.ts:893`, `src/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder-helpers.ts:184`, `src/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder-helpers.ts:201`). By contrast, the declaration-aware sibling path is `implementerRectifyOp`, whose `build()` routes through rectification prompts and whose `parse()` already calls `parseTestEditDeclarations(output)` and returns `testEditDeclarations` without throwing on empty output (`src/operations/autofix-implementer.ts:27`, `src/operations/autofix-implementer.ts:33`, `src/operations/autofix-implementer.ts:49`). The shared declaration model already supports the required four reasons, including `mock_structure`, and `parseTestEditDeclarations()` is tolerant: malformed or absent blocks are dropped and valid blocks are parsed into structured records (`src/operations/test-edit-declaration.ts:13`, `src/operations/test-edit-declaration.ts:31`, `src/operations/test-edit-declaration.ts:61`, `src/operations/test-edit-declaration.ts:93`).

The main rectification cycle in `buildPlanForStrategy()` already has the sink/postValidate machinery needed for this feature. It creates one shared `DeclarationSink`, prepends mechanical fix strategies, then appends `makeFullSuiteRectifyStrategy(story, config)` before the declaration-aware autofix strategies (`src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:140`, `src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:143`, `src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:163`, `src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:175`). After each validate pass, `postValidate` converts `sink.mockHandoffs` into `TestEditDeclaration`-shaped values, validates them with `validateMockStructureFiles()`, rewrites the sink to retain only valid mock handoffs for the test-writer, merges valid declarations with `sink.testEdits`, and calls `applyTestEditDeclarations(findings, allDeclarations, story, invalid)` (`src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:190`, `src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:194`, `src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:201`, `src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:204`, `src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:206`, `src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:209`). That means the only missing piece in the main cycle is getting the full-suite strategy to emit parsed declarations into the same sink, mirroring `makeAutofixImplementerStrategy()`, whose `extractApplied()` already partitions `mock_structure` into `sink.mockHandoffs` and the other reasons into `sink.testEdits` (`src/operations/autofix-implementer-strategy.ts:27`, `src/operations/autofix-implementer-strategy.ts:48`, `src/operations/autofix-implementer-strategy.ts:51`).

`applyTestEditDeclarations()` is the other required behavior change. Today it only re-tags `prd_contract` declarations when `f.file === d.file && f.fixTarget === "source"`, then flips the finding to `fixTarget: "test"` and attaches `meta.prdContractDeclaration`; invalid quotes append a `prd_quote_mismatch` advisory; invalid mock-structure declarations append `mock_structure_invalid_files` advisories (`src/operations/apply-test-edit-declarations.ts:31`, `src/operations/apply-test-edit-declarations.ts:37`, `src/operations/apply-test-edit-declarations.ts:52`, `src/operations/apply-test-edit-declarations.ts:65`). Failing-test findings come from `testFailureToFinding()` and have no `fixTarget` at all, so the current predicate will never re-tag them (`src/findings/adapters/test-failure.ts:4`). The scoped relaxation must therefore be limited to `fixTarget == null && source === "test-runner"` so test-runner failures become test-targetable while lint/typecheck findings with null `fixTarget` keep their existing routing (`src/findings/adapters/test-failure.ts:6`, `src/findings/adapters/test-failure.ts:10`, `src/operations/apply-test-edit-declarations.ts:39`).

Signature and dependency impact is localized but not single-file. The strategy factory currently has two production call sites: the main cycle in `buildPlanForStrategy()` and regression rectification in `run-regression.ts`, plus several unit and integration tests instantiate it directly (`src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:163`, `src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:243`, `src/execution/lifecycle/run-regression.ts:353`). The spec explicitly scopes the new sink parameter to the main rectification call site and the non-blocking-fix path, but the function signature change still affects regression and existing tests, so implementation must either make the sink parameter optional or update all callers. The safest migration path is additive: introduce `fullSuiteRectifyOp`, export it from `src/operations/index.ts`, add a third `sink` parameter to `makeFullSuiteRectifyStrategy()` in a backward-compatible way if possible, then switch the main plan builder to pass the shared sink and the non-blocking path to pass `nbSink` with the #1227 note (`src/operations/index.ts:24`, `src/operations/index.ts:25`, `src/operations/index.ts:85`, `src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:225`, `src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts:243`).

The prompt-builder file-size constraint is real in the current codebase. `RectifierPromptBuilder.failingTestContext()` sits at the end of an already oversized class file (`src/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder.ts:883`), while the helper file already owns `testEditHeadline()` and `escapeHatchFor()` and is the natural place for a shared failing-test bullet-list helper (`src/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder-helpers.ts:184`, `src/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder-helpers.ts:201`). Existing prompt tests already cover `failingTestContext()` and the escape-hatch helpers, so story 1 should extend those rather than invent a new test surface (`test/unit/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder.test.ts:568`, `test/unit/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder.test.ts:573`, `test/unit/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder.test.ts:578`, `test/unit/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder.test.ts:402`). Existing operation coverage is also in place: `test/unit/operations/full-suite-rectify.test.ts` currently asserts the strategy name, appliesTo behavior, and that `fixOp` is `implementerOp`; that suite will need to pivot to the new op and any sink-aware signature changes (`test/unit/operations/full-suite-rectify.test.ts:28`, `test/unit/operations/full-suite-rectify.test.ts:63`, `test/unit/operations/full-suite-rectify.test.ts:68`). `test/unit/operations/apply-test-edit-declarations.test.ts` already exercises valid/invalid `prd_contract` behavior and invalid `mock_structure` advisories, making it the right place to add the new `test-runner` null-`fixTarget` case and the negative lint case (`test/unit/operations/apply-test-edit-declarations.test.ts:21`, `test/unit/operations/apply-test-edit-declarations.test.ts:121`, `test/unit/operations/apply-test-edit-declarations.test.ts:206`). `test/unit/operations/autofix-implementer-strategy.test.ts` already codifies the sink partition pattern to mirror for the full-suite strategy (`test/unit/operations/autofix-implementer-strategy.test.ts:148`, `test/unit/operations/autofix-implementer-strategy.test.ts:160`, `test/unit/operations/autofix-implementer-strategy.test.ts:198`). There are also integration tests around rectification routing and story orchestrator dispatch that may need adjustments once the full-suite strategy starts using a different op or constructor signature (`test/integration/execution/rectification-routing.test.ts:202`, `test/unit/execution/story-orchestrator.test.ts:1220`).

Primary risks are behavioral parity and routing regressions, not data migration. The feature must preserve the current failing-test listing text for `failingTestContext()` while adding a second method with the escape hatch, otherwise existing prompt snapshots and callers will drift. The full-suite strategy must keep claiming only `test-runner` `failed-test`/`execution-failed` findings and keep `coRun: "exclusive"`; changing strategy order or routing would be a separate feature. `applyTestEditDeclarations()` must not broaden re-tagging beyond test-runner findings with missing `fixTarget`, or lint/typecheck findings could start routing incorrectly. There is no external data migration: this is in-process prompt/strategy wiring only. The implementation migration path is code-only and low-friction: add the new prompt helper/method, add the new op and barrel export, upgrade the strategy and main-cycle sink wiring, then extend unit/integration tests to prove the end-to-end mock-structure handoff on the full-suite path.
